title: Subspace character sum Fourier vanishing
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $H$ be a linear subspace of $\mathbb{F}_2^n$, and let $\gamma\in\mathbb{F}_2^n$ with $\gamma\notin H$. Define a function on $\mathbb{F}_2^n$ by summing, over $y\in H$, the Walsh character indexed by $y$ and evaluated at the argument. The Fourier coefficient of this function at $\gamma$ is zero.
